lesson.title: Procedure 108 – DESCRIPTIONS
objectives: Transmit detailed/precise descriptions to support reasonable suspicion and officer safety.
Use DESC-PER/DESC-VEH to add/edit/view Supplemental Information and understand DUPCAN carryover.
Handle name/plate alerts, automatic Informer/NYSPIN runs, and supervisor review of warrant hits.
Rebroadcast and document additional description details received over the radio.

questions.stem: Procedure 108: According to scope, detailed descriptions help provide what for a stop and frisk?
questions.hints: Focus on the exact requirement on pages 43–44.

source.coverage: Legal bulletins stress detailed/precise descriptions: clothing type/color, exact location, and if weapons are involved; good description provides reasonable suspicion for stop/frisk; attempt to be complete/exact.
